items.meta_title: Free VPN, No Registration Needed | VpnHood! CONNECT
items.meta_description: Free, open-source VPN engineered to stay undetectable behind firewalls and DPI filters. Free on Android; Premium on iOS, Windows and Linux.
items.hero_desc: Free, open source, and undetectable by design, so there's nothing for a firewall to single out and block. No registration, no personal data required.
items.note_free_availability: The free plan is funded by ads, so it is not available in China, Russia or other countries where ads are not served. Premium has no such limit.
items.screenshot_desc: Manage every aspect of your connection. Customize your global presence, select specific apps for VPN usage, optimize local traffic routing, and enjoy the app in your native language, you have complete control.

items.stealth_title: Undetectable where other free VPNs get blocked
items.stealth_desc: Free VPNs are usually the first thing a restrictive network learns to recognize. Their protocols are well documented, and filtering them is routine. VpnHood was built for those networks: it shapes its traffic to look like ordinary encrypted browsing, so there is no familiar signature to match. On restricted public Wi-Fi, a locked-down work network, or behind a national filter, the connection is designed to keep working.
items.unlimited_desc: Most free VPNs give you a few gigabytes a month and a throttled connection, because the limits are what sell the upgrade. VpnHood! CONNECT does not work that way: the free plan has no data cap, no speed cap and no time limit.
items.unlimited_data_desc: The VpnHood! server can enforce a monthly quota per user; on the free servers none is set. Use it all month, for anything, and no counter runs down.
items.unlimited_speed_desc: The server can cap speed per user too, and on the free servers it does not. What you feel is capacity, not a limit: free servers carry many more people, so your share rises and falls with how busy they are. Premium servers are more powerful and shared only among premium users, which is why they are consistently faster. How to test your VPN speed properly.
items.locations_desc: Every free country is included in Premium too. Go nearest for speed, or wherever the content lives for reach.
items.pending_desc: Enjoy a seamless and private experience with our free, open-source VPN. No registration or personal data is required. Experience high-speed connectivity for all your online activities with no speed or time limits, ensuring your digital life stays private and uninterrupted.
items.premium_title: Enhance the capabilities of the free version
items.premium_desc: The free plan is funded by ads, so it is not available in every country, and on iOS, Windows and Linux it needs a premium code. Premium adds more locations, ultra fast servers, five devices at once and an app without ads.
items.typer_more_servers: More ultra-fast servers on the more locations.
